correctness.rationale: For each subset T, direct downset counting gives w_S(T)=2^{|T|}-2^{|T∩S|}. The sublevel order complex is naturally the barycentric subdivision of the downward-closed face complex. A chosen v∈S yields a filtered, integral, unimodular basis with c_sigma=∂[v,sigma] and ∂[v,sigma]=c_sigma; codimension-one inequalities prove c_sigma occurs at w(sigma), while [v,sigma] occurs at 2 w(sigma). The only unpaired generator is [v] in H0. Counting faces by the two cardinalities proves every interval with its grade and exact multiplicity. Direct mod-2/3/5 boundary matrix reductions checked n=2..8 (35 cases), and literal poset order-complex reductions checked n=2..5 (14 cases); these finite tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The centered furtherness filtration was introduced with degree-zero results, and the nonempty Boolean subset poset is the canonical full-dimensional distributive-lattice test case. The theorem supplies all integral homology persistence groups and every inclusion map for every center rank, revealing exact exponential births, doubling deaths, binomial multiplicities and higher-degree intervals. Its explicit unimodular chain splitting is a structural calculation, not a graph-counting or low-degree special-case computation; this exact benchmark is motivated by the recently defined invariant. No general claim for arbitrary posets or an equivariant homotopy splitting is made.
